spans.s:
Irugapadaṇḍanātha
son of Daṇḍanātha Baicappa, minister of King Harihara an. Bukka of Vijayanagar. Inss. of his are d. A.

(p. 156), Epi. Ind. VII. p.. 115 an. 116.
--Nānārtharatnamālā ascribed to him; probably written for him by Bhāskara. Ed.. Deccan Col.. Res.
. The Ekākṣarakāṇḍa separately noted (Pejawar 105 (d)) is the opening section of this work.

Irugapanātha
name of Uddaṇḍa, the author of Mallikāmāruta, a. stated in the work.
